🙏🏼 Ruling: the gate goes INSIDE the verb, not the caller. Recorded in row (event 6438).

Reason: the verb is irreversible, so a caller-side guard is omittable by construction — "any caller can not ask" is a certainty for some future caller, not a risk. It also matches the row's own design: the other two irreversibility guards (memento verify, one-shot marker) already live in the verb, and the row says guard this "same as the memento overwrite" — at the mutation site. A caller obligation is documentation; documentation isn't enforcement and fails silently first time it's skipped.
Shape: self_respin() verifies the memento, fires the ask itself (response_default=yes, sane timeout), and schedules /clear only on yes/timeout-yes — no kwarg lets a caller pre-supply the answer or skip the ask.
Gate for the diff: a test proving no code path reaches the schedule without the ask running, and a real human "no" schedules nothing.
Noted Rick's ruling: my Property 2 (proxy-exclusion) is downgraded — proxy is observer-only, so it's now a config-dependency note, not a build item. My ruling doesn't rest on it.
